name_en: Kaga oshizushi — pressed sushi layered and rested overnight
summary_ja: 酢でしめた魚とすし飯、紺のりを木枠に重ね、一晩重石をして寝かせる。季節や行事で使う魚を変え、加賀では熊笹で包む「笹ずし」や柿の葉を使う「柿の葉ずし」も伝わる祭りの料理。
summary_en: Vinegar-cured fish, sushi rice, and nori are layered in a wooden mold and left overnight under a weight — a festival dish whose fish changes with the season, with Kaga variants wrapped in bamboo grass or persimmon leaves.
source_title: 押しずし 石川県｜うちの郷土料理

name_en: Hinezushi — fish fermented with rice in a wooden tub
summary_ja: 塩漬けの魚を米や赤唐辛子、山椒の葉とともに桶に詰め、1〜2か月かけて発酵させる奥能登のなれずし。開ける瞬間まで中の様子はわからず、塩加減や気候によって味が変わり、同じ人が漬けても仕上がりは一定しないという。
summary_en: Salted fish is packed into a tub with rice, chili, and sansho leaves and left to ferment for a month or two — a narezushi from the Oku-Noto area whose flavor is said to shift with the salt level and the weather, varying even when the same person prepares it each time.
source_title: ひねずし 石川県｜うちの郷土料理
